prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic candid high-angle smartphone portrait of an approved adult woman interacting with a ginger cat on a rustic patio.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult Asian woman with a soft round face and natural dewy skin, crouched low and looking up sideways with a shy playful closed-mouth smile. She wears a sage-green ribbed open-back knit top with long sleeves and denim shorts, extending one sleeve-covered hand toward a ginger cat.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle portrait on rough concrete beside a wooden table with a pink geometric runner, cat on a leash near her, eyes and gentle interaction as the focal points.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural daylight, soft shadows, candid smartphone realism, charming playful and grounded mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-detail vertical smartphone image, sharp eyes, realistic knit, denim, cat fur, wood, cloth, concrete, and accurate anatomy.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic high-angle smartphone portrait of an approved adult Asian woman crouched on a rough concrete patio and interacting gently with a ginger cat. She has natural dewy skin, a soft round face, and a shy playful closed-mouth smile while looking up sideways. Dress her in a sage-green ribbed open-back knit top with long sleeves and denim shorts, with one sleeve-covered hand extended toward the cat. Include a wooden table with a pink geometric runner, cat leash, soft daylight, realistic textures, and candid charm.
